description.en: Research agent suite: long-horizon goal control with auditable evidence chains, cron scheduling, multi-agent expert teams, self-evolving research memory (FTS5 + RRF recall), project workspaces, and a custom workspace UI.
description.zh: 研究型 Agent 套件：可审计证据链的长程目标管控、定时调度、多 Agent 专家团队、自进化研究记忆（FTS5 + RRF 召回）、项目工作区与自定义工作区 UI。
